crew.overview: The Grand Budapest Hotel tells of a legendary concierge at a famous European hotel between the wars and his friendship with a young employee who becomes his trusted protégé. The story involves the theft and recovery of a priceless Renaissance painting, the battle for an enormous family fortune and the slow and then sudden upheavals that transformed Europe during the first half of the 20th century.
crew.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel

crew.overview: A middle aged carpenter, who requires state welfare after injuring himself, is joined by a single mother in a similar scenario.
crew.title: I, Daniel Blake

crew.original_title: The Wind That Shakes the Barley
crew.overview: In 1920s Ireland young doctor Damien O'Donovan prepares to depart for a new job in a London hospital. As he says his goodbyes at a friend's farm, British Black and Tans arrive, and a young man is killed. Damien joins his brother Teddy in the Irish Republican Army, but political events are soon set in motion that tear the brothers apart.
crew.title: The Wind That Shakes the Barley

crew.overview: When the creator of a popular video game system dies, a virtual contest is created to compete for his fortune.
crew.title: Ready Player One

crew.overview: Ricky and his family have been fighting an uphill struggle against debt since the 2008 financial crash. An opportunity to wrestle back some independence appears with a shiny new van and the chance to run a franchise as a self-employed delivery driver. It's hard work, and his wife's job as a carer is no easier. The family unit is strong but when both are pulled in different directions everything comes to breaking point.
crew.title: Sorry We Missed You

crew.overview: Narrowly avoiding jail, new dad Robbie vows to turn over a new leaf. A visit to a whisky distillery inspires him and his mates to seek a way out of their hopeless lives.
crew.title: The Angels' Share

crew.overview: Four undying warriors who've secretly protected humanity for centuries become targeted for their mysterious powers just as they discover a new immortal.
crew.title: The Old Guard

crew.original_title: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
crew.overview: In 1926, Newt Scamander arrives at the Magical Congress of the United States of America with a magically expanded briefcase, which houses a number of dangerous creatures and their habitats. When the creatures escape from the briefcase, it sends the American wizarding authorities after Newt, and threatens to strain even further the state of magical and non-magical relations.
crew.title: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them

crew.overview: When Bond's latest assignment goes gravely wrong, agents around the world are exposed and MI6 headquarters is attacked. While M faces challenges to her authority and position from Gareth Mallory, the new Chairman of the Intelligence and Security Committee, it's up to Bond, aided only by field agent Eve, to locate the mastermind behind the attack.
crew.title: Skyfall

crew.overview: The story of an Indian boy named Pi, a zookeeper's son who finds himself in the company of a hyena, zebra, orangutan, and a Bengal tiger after a shipwreck sets them adrift in the Pacific Ocean.
crew.title: Life of Pi

crew.overview: During a writing slump, playwright J.M. Barrie meets a widow and her four children, all young boys—who soon become an important part of Barrie’s life and the inspiration that lead him to create his masterpiece. Peter Pan.
crew.title: Finding Neverland

details.biography:
Fergus Clegg has spent the past 25 years working in the art department and set decoration departments on films ranging from “Skyfall” and “Spectre” to “Bridget Jones’s Diary,” “The Life of Pi,” “The Grand Budapest Hotel,” and “The Wind that Shakes the Barley.”. 

On many films, Clegg has worked with the renowned British film director Ken Loach. He has worked with Ken as both an art director and production designer, including on his most recent film, “Sorry We Missed You.”. 

On other films, Clegg's roles have included art director, production buyer, and assistant set decorator. 

Clegg's career began with numerous music videos and TV commercials.

Information above via their homepage.
details.name: Fergus Clegg
